lines: Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Yannamani, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 933,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹30.79 crore are scheduled for on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by listing notice.
Pre-offer capital shares carry a 6 months from allotment lock-in, so retained holdings may give a later conversation; allotment date not confirmed.
Unknown: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding, so gain and retained value cannot yet be stated.
